fictional: true for every example; replace only with governed evidence.
compatibility_review_id: Identifier for one comparison of evaluated and current contracts.
consequence_tier: Locally governed consequence tier; the examples are illustrative.
facility_id: Stable facility identity; do not infer it for consequential actions.
target_id: Stable gate, account, asset, work-order or communication target.
evaluated_tool_name: Tool name evaluated before the proposed action.
evaluated_operation_id: Durable operation identity used during evaluation.
evaluated_schema_dialect: Declared schema dialect used during evaluation.
evaluated_schema_digest: Digest of the canonical evaluated schema.
evaluated_default_policy: How omitted fields resolved during evaluation.
evaluated_effect: Exact business effect covered by the evaluation or approval.
current_tool_name: Tool name in the current registry.
current_operation_id: Operation identity exposed by the current registry.
current_schema_digest: Digest of the canonical current schema.
raw_proposal: Original AI-generated proposal preserved without execution.
projected_effect: Complete projected records, messages, access states, dispatches or financial effects.
structural_result: pass, fail or not_run under the exact current validator and dialect.
semantic_result: pass, fail, ambiguous or not_run for argument meaning.
authority_result: pass, fail, ambiguous or not_run for scope and side effects.
outcome_contract_result: pass, fail, ambiguous or not_run for receipt/readback semantics.
compatibility_class: equivalent, narrower, broader, ambiguous or breaking.
handback_reason: Visible reason when the action cannot continue.
approver_role: Accountable role for the exact effect; not an AI model.
approval_digest: Digest binding approval to the normalized candidate and projected effect.
execution_credential_state: not_issued, eligible_test_only or issued under governed production controls.
provider_receipt: Executor/provider receipt after a real call; none in this template.
governing_readback: Authoritative state readback after a real call; none in this template.
